provenance.revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: subtle ceiling-attached Back Decor accent for a side-view 2D exploration platformer
Primary request: Generate exactly one isolated, connected, low-profile chain-and-web frieze spanning a three-tile-wide by one-tile-tall composition canvas. The complete prop is attached continuously along the top anchor edge and must be fully visible without cropping.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with alpha; absolutely no depicted environment, scenery, floor, ground plane, cast shadow, border, or frame.
Subject: one connected decorative frieze only, made from dark sagging chain arcs interwoven with thin torn cobweb threads, exactly two small cloth knots, and a few tiny irregular dangling chain links. Preserve abundant open negative space inside and around the structure. Use an asymmetrical rhythm with no centered pendant and no focal centerpiece. Keep all hanging elements very short: none extends lower than roughly half of one tile from the top anchor.
Style/medium: production-ready 16-bit pixel art sprite, crisp hard pixel edges, deliberate chunky pixel clusters, restrained one-pixel details, no smoothing and no antialiasing. It should read as subtle noninteractive background set dressing, decorative only, with no collider implied.
Composition/framing: exact 3:1 landscape aspect ratio; one complete connected prop centered on the canvas; full subject shown; ceiling attachment runs near the top boundary; visual mass stays in the upper half; no cropping.
Color palette: predominantly very dark navy and deep indigo, supported by muted blue-purple midtones. Allow only one or two tiny restrained pale-blue edge pixels total. Extremely low-key, non-glowing, subordinate contrast.
Constraints: exactly one connected prop; exactly two small cloth knots; a few tiny irregular dangling links; transparent background; complete subject; abundant negative space; asymmetrical; PNG output; no text.
Avoid: bright white mass, glow, luminous pickup appearance, chandelier, hazard, focal object, icicle silhouette, centered pendant, lamp, weapon, character, creature, bones large enough to read as pickups, readable writing, dense curtain, long dangling elements, second object, floor plane, shadow, scenery, text, UI, border, watermark, photorealism, painterly blur, smoothing, antialiasing.
